title: Trained MaleCNS - Eighteen, round 14
description: The club member's round seed 14, one of ten (seeds 7-16) over all eighteen holes. Every stroke starts from 400 ms of simulated activity across all 166,700 MaleCNS neurons, read out by readout 20260917T165536Z, which was fitted offline on practice shots from the front nine only. The connectome itself never learns. It never practised on holes 10 to 18, so its back nine is played on ground it has not seen.

controller.label: MaleCNS + TRAINED READOUT
controller.description: The same MaleCNS v1.0 connectome simulation. Club, aim and power are read out of descending-neuron activity by weights fitted offline from practice shots (a putter gate, a club head and putter / full-swing heads; docs/TRAINING.md). The connectome's synapses are unchanged.

notes: 99 local file path(s) replaced with '<local path removed>'
trajectory samples rounded to 4 decimals (0.1 mm, 0.1 ms) for size; the source run re-simulates bit for bit with `fly-golf replay 20260927T204841Z-3ed9b1`
